verificationTarget: Editor exposes a bounded visible textarea island for the selected ready text block, keeps local draft edits in the active text-block island, commits only by explicit Save/Ctrl+Enter through text-block.rich-inline.replace, reloads the committed text from a live local Backend read envelope, and preserves existing add-node, migration, and reorder gates.
summary: Done: Editor commit 6f59f7269322abfe3428d4df6f4ba0ee6ab0078f adds a bounded visible text-block textarea island. The slice stores Backend source package snapshots for api and mutation-result reads, reads and replaces only the first text inline run of a package 3/document 4 text-block, wires explicit Save/Cancel and pending-mutation gates through the existing active island commit runner, protects canvas selection/reorder from textarea and editor button events, and extends the live browser smoke to type, save, reload, and then reorder through a local Backend server. The slice intentionally keeps WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, multi-run rich-inline editing, field-chip editing, table/media/columns authoring, durable draft persistence, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, and map truth closed.
